message.content: Web research task. You have WebSearch and WebFetch (load via ToolSearch if needed). Verify, from CURRENT official Polymarket sources (docs.polymarket.com, polymarket.com/learn, official changelog/blog, credible recent reporting), each of these beliefs a trading bot depends on, and report TRUE / CHANGED / CANNOT-VERIFY for each with source URL and date: (1) crypto 5m/15m up/down markets hold taker orders 250ms before matching and the order cannot be cancelled during the hold (reintroduced ~2026-06-05); (2) taker fee on these markets is 0.07*p*(1-p) per share, makers pay nothing and there is a ~20% maker rebate program; (3) orderMinSize=5 shares and tick size 0.01 -- AND whether tick becomes 0.001 when price is above 0.96 or below 0.04 (matters: the bot buys asks up to 0.99); (4) settlement rule for 5m crypto up/down: 30-second trailing TWAP of a Chainlink price stream evaluated at BOTH the open and close boundaries ('twap-30s-streams'; 60s for 15m) -- and whether ANY change to this rule was announced after 2026-08-07; (5) which crypto up/down families exist now (5m, 15m, hourly, 4h, daily?) and which coins (btc, eth, sol, xrp, doge -- any added recently?); (6) CLOB API rate limits for order placement and market data; (7) any newly announced fee changes, market suspensions, or crypto-binary rule changes in July-August 2026. Return a numbered list, one verdict per item, with exact quotes where a doc states the fact.
